infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: The acceptance suite asks for tracking permission to check that the prompt and the advertising identifier work.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: The acceptance suite uses Face ID to check that authentication works
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The acceptance suite opens the camera when you tap a camera button.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: The acceptance suite saves a test image to your photo library when you tap Save.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: The acceptance suite reads your location to verify CLLocationManager
